bullets.text: GAO: Treasury must refinance about $9.7T of maturing securities in FY2026 (roll/refinance, not pay-down).
Debt to the Penny (22 Sep 2026): TPDO ~$40.10T; debt held by the public ~$32.38T; intragovernmental ~$7.72T. Always name which stock.
30-year Treasury CMT 5.40% (Wed 23 Sep official; +11 bp vs Tue 5.29%). Six percent has not printed; watch hold through a long-term borrow date.

Treasury General Account (DTS TGA Closing Balance open_today_bal) 22 Sep 2026: ~$957.4B (was ~$1,004.4B on 21 Sep). Cash buffer, not a buyback program. (H.4.1 Wed 16 Sep week print was ~$991.7B level / ~$877.0B week-average.)
Treasury long-end liquidity-support buybacks: at least $4B per operation in 10–20y and 20–30y nominal sectors, effective 9 Sep through 4 Nov 2026 (was $2B max).
CBO Outlook: debt held by the public ~101% of GDP in 2026 (context for 1pp full-stock thought experiment vs ~0.3% first-year cash on what rolls).
